about: Toy headless F ecology (research/body-plans/prototype/f_ecology.py). Times are medians over seeds; None = reached in <= half the seeds within T. demo_s = 25 s (eco start) + sim_s/speed. F's ecology ticks at 20 Hz, so speed xK = 20K ticks per real second.
